issue: Path Traversal / Arbitrary File Read in Introspection Loader
recommendation: Sanitize the `timestamp` parameter by stripping directory traversal sequences (`..`) or validating it using `Path::file_name` to prevent escaping the cache directory.

issue: Path-Relative Command Execution (Binary Hijacking & Privilege Escalation)
recommendation: Replace all relative binary invocations with fully qualified absolute system paths (e.g., `/usr/sbin/modprobe`, `/usr/bin/rdmsr`, `/usr/bin/systemctl`).

issue: Broken Mutex & Concurrent SQLite Lockups (`SQLITE_BUSY`) in Async Manager
recommendation: Redesign the manager to safely borrow the mutex-protected `_indexer` connection, and configure SQLite with WAL mode and a busy timeout to resolve database access collisions.

issue: Schema-as-Code and OSCAL Gaps: Ad-Hoc Structs & Lack of Standardized Compliance Serialization
recommendation: Refactor ad-hoc Rust structs into versioned Protocol Buffers schemas (`prost`). Map the security posture metadata to OSCAL (Open Security Controls Assessment Language) Component Definitions.

issue: Unbounded Cache Memory Growth leading to Denial of Service (OOM)
recommendation: Replace the plain unbounded `HashMap` in `IntrospectionCache` with an LRU cache or set a strict maximum capacity limit combined with a TTL eviction policy.
Consolidate the XML parsing inside `IntrospectionParser::parse` and refactor `ServiceScanner` to consume it, rather than utilizing dummy implementations.
